    if isinstance(address_string, bytes):
        address_string = str(address_string, encoding="utf-8")
    address_string = re.sub("(&)|(&)", "&", address_string)
    re_tokens = re.compile(
        r"""
    \(*\b[^\s,;#&()]+[.,;)\n]*   # ['ab. cd,ef '] -> ['ab.', 'cd,', 'ef']
    |
    [#&]                       # [^'#abc'] -> ['#']

        else:

        elif label not in tagged_components:
